network.title: Connection issue
network.explanation: The connection failed. Check your internet connection and server status.

upload.title: Upload issue
upload.explanation: The source could not be accepted. Use a valid JPG, PNG or WEBP within the upload limits.

ai.title: AI provider issue
ai.explanation: An AI operation did not complete. Check provider configuration or continue with manual part selection.

geometry.title: Vector geometry issue
geometry.explanation: The geometry did not pass deterministic checks. Review the boundary or retry tracing.

parts.title: Part review required
parts.explanation: A part is missing or uncertain. Select its region, create a proposal with AI, or leave the slot blank.

validation.title: Validation blocked
validation.explanation: The output did not pass vector integrity checks. Correct the artwork and validate again.

export.title: Export issue
export.explanation: A requested file could not be generated. Existing validated individual files are preserved.

auth.title: Access issue
auth.explanation: The request could not be authorized. Reconnect through the secured website.

job.title: Processing stopped
job.explanation: The job stopped or exceeded a timeout. Completed parts remain stored; inspect details before retrying.

storage.title: Storage issue
storage.explanation: A required project file could not be read or saved. Contact the operator if this persists.

unknown.title: Processing issue
unknown.explanation: The cause is not yet known. Inspect the safe diagnostic details before retrying.
